literalRow.description: The prepared source information adapter retains exact Garcia-Ramirez 2022 Data Sheet 1 tables and primary Methods context for adult 8–25-week L2–L5 Shox2/Chx10 whole-cell recordings. It preserves four alternative partitions of one 171-recorded-observation pool (143 Shox2 and 28 Chx10), 192 literal mean ± SD summaries and 48 source comparisons, with original table labels/units/locators, separate 51-Shox2-mouse and 6-Chx10-mouse context, and prior-study reuse of 60 Shox2 recordings from 28 of those 51 mice as a subset. Figshare article 20428674/file 36551718 original 687,234 B DOCX is pinned by MD5 cd540639b14fda1fd1149b235384b795 and SHA-256 7ef955d8378020d95eeff07be83ad0c602699337fdb89b79f6796c3e96b845e2; the exact CC BY 4.0 asset metadata and primary article XML are retained. Complete only after current dedicated-route keyboard/narrow-screen/actual-download checks and current package/source-registry/manifest acceptance; the queue remains in progress. The four partitions are not independent cohorts, animals or molecular types; unprinted fAHP/F-I units and individual sex/age/cell-to-animal mapping remain unknown. Raw source statements are held without recalculation or missing assignments. No raw ABF/trace/per-cell roster or Supplementary Figure 1 image is bundled in this adapter scope, and zero new molecular profiles, physical cells, observed morphology, internal objects, cross-source identities, atlas placements, REG, M2 or M4 admissions are authorized
